name: Wintuner GUI
description: WinTuner GUI is a modern PowerShell-based graphical interface for managing Microsoft Intune Win32 apps via WinGet packages. Search WinGet packages, create .wtpackage files, and deploy them to Intune, with update checks for existing apps. Features include fuzzy app discovery, persistent settings, interactive M365 login, and a JSON settings store for end-to-end Intune app lifecycle management.
author: Manuel Höfler

securityCheck.aiSummary: Overall, the code appears suitable for an Intune-driven management tool with Graph API interactions and proper DPAPI use. The primary concern is potential remote code execution risk from externally-supplied scriptblocks used in update/deploy workflows; mitigate by validating or sandboxing scriptblocks and avoiding passing raw scriptblocks from untrusted sources. No hardcoded credentials or obvious credential theft patterns detected. No obfuscated code detected.

noRemoteExecution.reason: ScriptBlock parameters ($BuildPackage, $ValidateArtifact, $DeployPackage) are invoked via the & operator. If untrusted user input or external modules supply these scriptblocks, this enables arbitrary code execution on the host. Recommend restricting scriptblock sources, validating content, or refactoring to avoid external scriptblocks.
